plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.45 arcseconds per year, measured over 14 years (a very confident measurement), which differs from the catalog value.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = 0.85 mag is red, as for early-T and the reddest L brown dwarfs.
Its infrared brightness stays constant within the measurement errors.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a T3 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (T5) fits clearly worse.
